name: What are the typical steps in a cabinet refacing project?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical steps in a cabinet refacing project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The refacing process follows a sequential order to ensure a clean finish. First, all cabinet doors, drawer fronts, and old hardware are removed. Next, installers inspect, clean, and prep the face frames and exposed exterior end panels. A new veneer or laminate layer matching your selected door style is precisely cut, adhered, and trimmed over the existing framing. Finally, brand-new doors, drawer fronts, soft-close hinges, and pulls are installed and aligned for smooth operation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Old doors and hardware are removed, exposed frames are prepped and covered with matching veneer, and new doors, drawer fronts, and hardware are installed.
